A file whose download has not yet started has nothing to hand over, so the new source is simply applied when its download starts. Choosing a service during a pause works as described above, except that the download stays paused: a service that can accept the link in use takes it over immediately (this is visible by the icon), and a service that first needs to prepare a copy shows Preparing … and takes over the download only after resuming. help.settings.downloads.download_behavio.backTranslation: Download behavior and limits: Download folder (with a Browse button) and Maximum simultaneous downloads. Under Advanced settings: Data checkpoint interval and Graceful stop timeout (better left unchanged), Local network connections (off by default) to allow downloads from devices on your private network, and Do not ask for confirmation of local connections so as not to be asked every time. Even when this is allowed, DebridPulse never connects to the computer it runs on or to other local addresses that do not belong to a private network. Also there: Provider polling interval (how often a service is polled about the progress of work it is preparing), Full sync interval (how often downloads are reconciled with all enabled premium service accounts that provide a list of their transfers; 0 disables syncing), and Retries on file detection failure and Retry delay (minutes) (how many times and after how long a failed file detection is retried — for any service, including network sources).

help.settings.access_integrations.only_b.backTranslation: Only the built-in administrator can sign in to a standalone installation. Other people's accounts left over from the time when the installation was a server are not deleted or converted: their data is kept, but they cannot be used to sign in while the installation remains standalone. In standalone mode there is no “User accounts” card; these accounts can be managed again when the installation becomes a server again.

help.settings.access_integrations.integr.backTranslation: Integration accounts are intended for automation and cannot sign in to these pages. Issue token shows a new token only once, so copy it right away; tools pass it as {literal}. Each token sees only the jobs submitted with it. Revoke immediately ends the token's validity without affecting anything already submitted with it.

Delivery profiles for integrations tell an external application, for example Sonarr or Radarr, which categories it may send jobs to, which source types it may send (Source types), which of its tokens may use the profile (Allowed API tokens) and where it will find the finished files (DP download path in the DebridPulse downloads folder and External import path — the same folder as the application sees it). Files are shared where they lie: nothing is copied, moved or deleted for the application. The download client interfaces stay unavailable until the profile has a category, a source type and an allowed API token that is active.

help.settings.access_integrations.admini.backTranslation: The administrator changes their display name, real name and email address, sets, changes or clears their password, and chooses Simple or Advanced mode in the My account section.

help.settings.users_access.user.backTranslation: User: adds downloads, pauses, resumes and retries them, changes their order; sees all transfers; can remove, cancel or switch a download only if no other account needs it any more, and otherwise withdraws their own request. Has their own Notifications page; settings are not available to them.

help.settings.users_access.user_accounts.backTranslation: User accounts is a list of all people showing role, sign-in method and whether the account is enabled. Add local account creates an account with a username and password. A role changed in the Edit user window applies immediately: that person's open pages reload with the new role, without signing out. Each person has a DebridPulse username separate from the display name: an OIDC account receives it on first sign-in, and it is the one used for local password sign-in; the pencil icon next to it in the Edit user window header changes it without affecting the saved password. Click an account's name to open its details and activity; there you can revoke any outstanding request individually. Disable and Remove first show how many outstanding download requests the account has; those requests are revoked, a transfer that someone else also requested continues, and completed downloads are never affected. Disabling also ends the account's sign-in sessions and stops its tokens; if an account is removed, its history is kept and its own notification settings are deleted. If an OIDC identity whose account was removed signs in again, a new account is created for it, which stays disabled until you enable it. Merge joins two or more accounts into one, which you choose to keep; two accounts sharing a verified email address are flagged, but only "Merge" joins them. DebridPulse always keeps at least one active administrator, and you cannot change your own role or disable your own account.

help.settings.data_maintenance.backups.backTranslation: The Backups button opens the list of backups. Select one backup and press Save backup (download a copy of it), Restore from backup or Delete; the Add backup button uploads a previously saved copy and adds it after verification. When restoring, DebridPulse pauses processing, creates a safety backup of the current state, verifies the selected copy once more, replaces the current database and settings, and restarts its services. If verification fails, nothing changes, and every pause set by you or by an *arr client returns to its previous state.

help.settings.data_maintenance.backups_r.backTranslation: Backups and retention: scheduled backup (on by default) to the folder from the Backup folder setting; the Backup interval, Backup retention period and Maximum backups kept settings are in the Additional backup and retention settings section. A backup is deleted as soon as it becomes too old or is no longer among the newest kept copies. The same section sets how often statistics snapshots are created and how long they are kept: this is a record of activity over the previous 24 hours, saved in the DebridPulse database. Snapshots are not reports: they are not sent anywhere and currently cannot be viewed in the interface. The Create backup button creates a copy immediately (only while backup is enabled).

help.settings.data_maintenance.database_.backTranslation: Database reset controls: turn on Allow database reset, press Reset database, type {literal} and press Erase database. This erases all downloads, their requests and history, events and statistics snapshots. Accounts, passwords, OIDC links, API tokens, personal notification settings and all settings are kept. DebridPulse always creates a safety backup first and cancels the reset if it could not be created. During the reset it stops running downloads and pauses processing, and after the reset it restores the previous pause state. Files already finished in your download folder are not deleted.

help.trouble.i_cannot_sign.last_resort_i.backTranslation: Last resort if no sign-in method works: this requires access to the computer DebridPulse runs on, and it temporarily removes all protection, so do this only on a trusted network. Docker does not restart the container by itself because of a failed health check.

help.topic.delivery_profiles.jobs_files..backTranslation: Submitting a job creates a download request owned by that application. help.topic.deployment_type.standalone.wi.backTranslation: If no password is set, no sign-in is required, and DebridPulse is used as the built-in administrator.

help.topic.deployment_type.what_switchin.backTranslation: No account is deleted. Other people's accounts keep their usernames, passwords, identity provider links and their saved "Enabled" or "Disabled" state. In standalone mode they cannot sign in, whatever that state is.
Switching clears the built-in administrator's password, disables sign-in by username and password and through OpenID Connect, and ends all browser sessions.

After this no sign-in is required: anyone who can reach DebridPulse at an address it accepts can use it as the built-in administrator. This is not limited to this computer and does not expire over time.

With a value of 0, no new snapshots are created.

help.topic.database_reset.intro.erases_d.backTranslation: Erases DebridPulse's download history so that it starts from zero. Use this only if you really want to start everything over.

help.topic.heading.what_removed_kept.backTranslation: What is deleted and what is kept

help.topic.database_reset.what_removed_k.backTranslation: Removed: transfers and the records of their files, download requests, external jobs, events and the "Activity log", as well as statistics snapshots.
Kept: accounts, passwords, OpenID Connect links, API tokens, personal notification settings and all settings. Downloaded files on disk are not deleted.

help.topic.database_reset.safeguards.res.backTranslation: "Reset database" works only while the "Allow database reset" setting is on, and asks for confirmation.

help.topic.database_reset.safeguards.pro.backTranslation: During the reset, processing is paused, and afterwards it returns to its previous state. A safety backup is created first; if it could not be created, nothing is erased.
